'''Reegesk''' was a [[Ranat]] [[thief]] who was lurking in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]]<ref name="Twitter" /> [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]]<ref name="ANH" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> The ranat was sat at a table with the [[Jawa]]<ref name="ANH" /> [[Het Nkik]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the [[Snivvian]]<ref name="ANH" /> [[Takeel]]<ref name="CL" /> when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] shot the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]], causing the trio<ref name="ANH" /> to briefly look over before going back about their business.<ref name="ANH AD">{{Film|IV}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> Reegesk had [[Color|brown]] [[Hair|fur]], black [[eye]]s, and wore a brown [[Clothing|robe]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Sadie Edon]] portrayed Reegesk<ref name="ShowMaster">{{WebCite|url=https://www.showmasterssales.com/collections/star-wars/products/sadie-eddoh-10x8-signed-in-black-star-wars-a-new-hope|text=Sadie Edden 10X8 Signed in Black - Star Wars|work=[http://showmasterssales.com Showmasters Comic Con Official Autograph Shop]|archivedate=2024-07-23|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/otlJp}}</ref> in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character was known as "Rat Face" or "Rodent" during production and a costume sketch by [[John Mollo]] suggested at one point the Ranat was meant to wear a face mask.<ref name="Suspects">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Reegesk was identified in a trivia contest post made by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] on the social media accounts for the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app on [[October 8]], [[2020]].<ref name="Twitter" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the [[1995]] ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'' anthology book, appearing in both the stories "[[Trade Wins: The Ranat's Tale]]" by [[Rebecca Moesta]]<ref name="Ranat">{{StoryCite|story=Trade Wins: The Ranat's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> and "[[Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale]]" by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="Jawa">{{StoryCite|story=Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> The character was originally planned to be named Aceatta, but this name was never used.<ref name="Suspects" />
